answer: Sybil resistance via age-weighted credibility. Attestation weight grows only with consecutive epochs of honest work, so a farm of fresh fakes is weightless. New identities enter an incubation 'island' where they vouch only for tiny amounts, never touching consensus. Real cost: a fake cluster must wait epochs before its weight matters, and a hidden 'karst' of beacon-re-keyed cells randomizes which fakes get paired. 'Raven' auditors, a rotating lane, re-run spot islands and burn confirmed clusters' stake. Cost: unbuyable time plus irrecoverable stake.
